fields.description: Turn on only if your scale prints barcode labels.
fields.label: Read scale labels

fields.description: First digits that mark an in-store weighed label, comma separated. Most scales use 2, some use 20 to 29.
fields.label: Prefixes

fields.description: How many digits after the prefix hold the item's number.
fields.label: Item digits

fields.description: How many digits hold the weight or the price.
fields.label: Value digits

fields.description: Whether those digits are money or a weight.
fields.label: Value holds

fields.description: The unit the weight digits add up to. Grams are converted.
fields.label: Weight UOM

fields.options:
The item's number on the label is matched against Item Barcode, so give each weighed item a barcode row holding the number the scale prints. Leading zeros do not matter.

Example with prefix 2, 5 item digits, 5 price digits: 2 01234 01250 8 is item 01234 at 12.50.
